entries.6f40d4ad62c48611: This is a securities company with its head office in Osaka City. The securities report classifies the financial instruments business and its ancillary operations as one category, the “Investment and Financial Services Business” (a single segment). Through financial capital markets, it provides customers with services covering both fundraising and asset management. It does not prepare consolidated financial statements, and the figures are those of the filing company on a non-consolidated basis. Operating revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,113 million. The breakdown shown in the securities report is: fee and commission income of ¥266 million, trading gains and losses of ¥593 million, financial income of ¥101 million, and other operating revenue of ¥151 million with no breakdown given. Its subsidiary Kameyama Shachu Co., Ltd. aims to conduct consulting and other business related to management and investment, but the securities report states that it is not currently engaged in substantive business activities.
